description: @EnableEurekaClient was removed from the Spring Cloud Netflix train. The annotated application class is affected. A second class merely mentions the annotation inside a comment and a string literal, and a third declares an unrelated annotation whose simple name shares a prefix; a matcher keying on raw text will wrongly flag both.
ground_truth_source: Hand-declared by inspection of the tree below. The harness runs ImpactStage's matcher over the tree and compares its output to this list; the fixture never states what the matcher should predict.
tuning_reason: The two false positives this fixture exposed (a prose mention in a comment and a longer identifier sharing a prefix) drove the identifier-boundary check and the comment/literal stripping in ImpactStage. The harness must not grade itself on a case its rules were derived from.
